description: A crust, and back by noon

participation.context: Took a crust, and went back for the call.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Would not cut a loaf for a man who would not sit.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Was not sent to a shop, and did not keep a dinner.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: the loaf is still a penny

story.body: You did not sit the meal. You took a crust. You left Monday's price where it was.

relations.note: the loaf is still a penny

title: Took a crust and went back

participation.context: Named the heat, and left both prices on Thursday's call.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the jaw was hot. You did not move the tooth forward. You did not open the coffer.
